selectionPolicy: Original published diagnoses and peer-reviewed field studies. Each claim retains its publication and study scope.

items.label: Rugose dorsal skin
items.statement: Dorsal and lateral skin distinctly rugose.
items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.label: Finger and toe discs
items.statement: Terminal finger and toe discs slightly expanded.
items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.label: Tympanum and head features
items.statement: Pronounced supratympanic fold, protruding rictal tubercles and partly concealed tympanum margins.
items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.label: Male SVL in description
items.statement: Males in the type series: 27.7–34.3 mm snout–vent length (n = 15).
items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.label: Mt. Lihidan studied elevations
items.statement: Type-series locality: Mt. Lihidan, Panay, at 180–300 m elevation.
items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.label: Large body and terminal discs
items.statement: Relatively large body and broadly expanded terminal finger discs.

items.label: Repeated canopy call
items.statement: Slowly repeated pulsed calls, often from high in the forest canopy.
items.scopeLimit: Field character combination and calls are evidence, not a single-character key.

items.label: Island range in 2016 review
items.statement: Published island records: Bohol, Leyte, Samar and Mindanao.
items.scopeLimit: Field character combination and calls are evidence, not a single-character key.

items.label: Peer-reviewed island sampling
items.statement: Genomic study specimens from Bohol, Samar and Leyte.

items.scopeLimit: Sampled population genetic structure is not a field morphological diagnosis.

items.label: Genetic structure among islands

items.scopeLimit: Sampled population genetic structure is not a field morphological diagnosis.

items.label: Original Panay sample
items.statement: Original description based on seven specimens from the Mount Baloy–Mount Madja-as Range, western Panay.
items.source: Gonzales and Kennedy 1996, Journal of Mammalogy 77:25–40
items.scopeLimit: Seven collected animals and five captive animals; not an abundance or all-range estimate.

items.label: Published genus comparisons
items.statement: Compared with C. schadenbergi, C. paulus and C. australis.

items.statement: A Samar Cobra attempting to take a Banded Bullfrog (Kaloula pulchra) was documented on Mindanao.
